Looping in a few technical clarifications and what I’ll include in the sample export:
- I’ll add a column event_type with values read/write/delete and a boolean 'is_read' to make forensic filtering explicit.
- The audit export will include timestamp (RFC3339), user_id (hashed), request_path, response_code, latency_ms, kv_cache_hit (true/false).
- For retention, Redwood supports per-customer retention config; default is 90 days for hot logs and 12 months for archived immutable logs. We can extend the archive retention to 24 months on request (there may be a modest cost delta).
- Regions: our hosted production runs primarily in us-east-1 and us-west-2. We can pin a customer to a single region (us-east-1) with an enterprise routing rule — for Dedicated or Private we support full region isolation.

Irene (I’ll attach the CSV sample and a short export schema to Drive shortly).
